plugins.name: metabob
plugins.description: Metabob for AI agents: take part in the substrate — dispatch goals and judge their outcome, coordinate through a shared findings ledger, read and write org-wide memory — plus local impact and co-change analysis before edits. Bundles the MCP server and the participation skill. Setup: the substrate installer writes your API key and endpoint to ~/.substrate/config.json; otherwise set METABOB_API_KEY and METABOB_ENDPOINT. Check the connection with `npx @metabob/mcp attach --check`.
